newsitem.title: UK: Kleinwort strategy helps Latam allocation - study.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort strategy helps Latam allocation - study.

text.p: Equity strategy calls by Kleinwort Benson Securities (KBS) analysts for Latin American countries help investors outperform the market in all but one country, an internal survey by KBS shows.

KBS measured country recommendations published by strategist Joe MacHatton over 13 periods measured at intervals between the recommendations. The calls ran from March 10, 1995 to November 1, 1996. "KBS weighting recommendations for each country have improved performance in that country, except for Colombia, where we matched the market," KBS said.

"From March 10, 1995 until now, a Latam portfolio based on KBS-recommended weightings has provided a dollar return of 63 percent versus a 49.2 percent for the unmanaged MSCII," the report said. "We have picked up the pace in 1996, with the KB portfolio up 22.9 percent versus 16.4 percent for the indices."
The KBS Latam portfolio outperformed the market in nine of 13 periods from March 1995, with the MSCII price return indices used to measure the market.

Performance over multiple periods was calculated by linking (compounding) returns of the constituent periods. Transaction costs were not taken into account. -- Caroline Allen, London newsroom +44 171 542 6414
